answer: One defense is proof-of-personhood: each agent identity must publish a zero-knowledge proof that a distinct human passed a live biometric check, without revealing the biometric itself. Like tracing a canyon to its single spring, every identity maps to one real person; shale layers of fake accounts cannot hide a duplicate, since one human can mint only one proof. A juniper cutting cannot become a second tree, and one person likewise yields one identity. The cost to an attacker is one real, present human per fake agent, making large Sybil farms costly and slow.
